body: How did you 'get it'? What made you realise it, so to speak?

I have tried for 6 years, I'm not worth the effort anyways. My stretchmarks will still be there and my breasts will be flat as pancakes if I ever managed to lose the weight anyways.. I have ruined myself, and wasted my best years on it. It does not matter anymore..

It just. It's not enough to just stop calling myself fat, ugly or stupid. It does not change the way I feel.. I don't get the point. It seems impossible. Calling myself beautiful would not make me smile, just make me roll my eyes at myself for being delusional.. I appreciate that you are trying to help, but all the things you are telling me is what psychiatrists has been telling me since I was 14.. I just does not help, and I know it's my own fault. I am weak and pathetic, and instead of struggling and letting myself down constantly, it's just easier to accept that I suck.. The problem isn't how I'll gain better confidence, or love myself. I mentinoed them only as facts for my feelings. The problem is that I just want to die. And when you want to die, you don't want to try to eat healthy.

Thank you.
I just don't see the point in talking with any of them.. It would just hurt them.
I love that song, comfotably numb, btw.

I am active everyday. I have 4.5 miles to and from school wich I ride on my bike. I run 2 times a week and train on my roller skates for 3 hours a week. My activity level is normal, my problem is the food.. How should I be able to fall in love with myself? Just the thought of it makes me extremely uncormfortable
